evidence: Protected executable acceptance commands, saved provider counters, and shared capacity snapshots.

nativeBareStartup.limitation: Codex app-server does not support ignoring user config. Native bare mode is now rejected before spawn.

nativeBeforeWindowsShellFix.limitation: Windows Store PowerShell repeatedly failed sandbox command launch; the two-minute agent deadline interrupted the turn and its usage remained unknown.

explicitDisposableBudgetOverride.reason: Historical interrupted turn had unknown usage; retained as unknown, previous report preserved

nativeAfterShellFixBeforeAccountingFix.limitation: This historical run initially counted only the last model request. The saved provider totals exposed the error; this report preserves both measurements.

nativeGoalCounter.interpretation: The paused native goal counter remains separate from measured model usage.

unboundObjective.acceptance: only checks old-feature.txt; intentionally unbound objective

accounting.method: Subtract the durable same-thread cumulative baseline; new threads begin at zero. Repeated absolute snapshots are not added again.
accounting.unknownUsage: Missing or malformed snapshots remain unknown. Decreasing counters mark the reused binding untrusted until a fresh thread is explicitly selected.

limits: These are bounded disposable smoke cases, not a long-running recovery or provider parity benchmark.
Native Codex goals remain experimental and opt-in; method-unavailable fallback does not hide authentication, network, or provider errors.
Native goals stay paused during explicit Yoke turns; independent executable checks determine Yoke completion.
Privacy exports omit thread identifiers, local root paths, and raw transcripts.
